role.now_reviewer: Role: reviewer — can decide on appeals
health.offline_hint: Start the server: npm start (port 8080). The page will retry automatically.
health.unavailable_hint: Saved results are fully available; new evaluations cannot be started.
error.title: Error.
outcome_hint.score_changed: The AI score was wrong; the total is recalculated.
outcome_hint.criterion_change: The criterion wording is ambiguous — a signal for the checklist editor.
outcome_hint.stands_explanation: The score is correct, but the explanation was incomplete.
outcome_hint.stands_coaching: The score is correct; the operator needs feedback.
dialogs.title: Dialogs
dialogs.lead: Load a set, run the evaluation and open the card of any dialog.
dialogs.hint_enter: Enter in search opens the only match
dialogs.empty_hint: Load a set by group_id via the organizers' API or upload a JSON file.
dialogs.nomatch_hint: Change the filters or search query.
dialogs.hint_open: Click an ID to open the card
dialogs.fetch_hint: The request goes through the server (the organizers' API does not allow browser requests). The result is cached.
dialogs.fetch_url: API URL (optional, otherwise from server settings)
dialogs.upload_hint: Format: an organizers' API response, an array of records or a single record. Choose a file or paste JSON.
dialogs.eval_confirm: Dialogs to evaluate: {n}. Already evaluated criteria are taken from cache. Continue?
card.seek: Jump to this point in the recording
card.audio_hint: Clicking a message time or evidence seeks the recording.
card.audio_unavailable: Recording via the server is unavailable — use «Open recording».
card.gross_note: The flag is recorded separately and does not affect the total score.
card.na_redistributed: Criterion not applicable: its weight {w} is redistributed among the applicable criteria, the total is normalized to 100.
card.checked_range_missed: messages checked: {n} — expected action not found
card.checked_range_ok: — the range the decision is based on
card.from_cache_hint: All criteria were taken from cache: the model was not called, time was not measured
card.dispute_as_operator_hint: Switches the role to «Operator» and opens the appeal form
card.eff_weight_hint: The criterion's share of the total after redistributing the weights of N/A criteria
card.checked_range_hint: — the expected action was not found in this range
card.no_eval_hint: Select it in the list and click «Evaluate selected».
appeal.comment_ph: Why is the score for this criterion wrong? Include message numbers.
appeal.hint: Once submitted, the score gets the «under appeal» status; the original value stays visible. The reviewer makes the decision.
cl.title: Checklist
cl.lead: Criteria, weights, answer types and evaluator instructions. Changes are saved as a new version; simulation writes nothing.
cl.no_versions_hint: The server has not loaded checklist v1 yet.
cl.discard_text: Switching versions will discard unsaved changes. Continue?
cl.activate_text: Version v{v} will become active: new evaluations will use it.
cl.restore_text: A new active version will be created — a copy of v{v}.
cl.templates_hint: Ready-made criteria: pick a template, edit it if needed and add it to the draft.
cl.simulate_hint: The draft is applied to the selected dialogs; results are shown next to the saved ones and are not stored.
cl.simulate_note: Simulation results were not saved. Saved scores are unchanged.
cl.save_hint: The current active version stays unchanged; a new version is created (draft or active).
cl.note_ph: e.g. «07 replaced with first response speed»
cl.save_apply_hint: Steps: save the version → activate → evaluate the selected dialogs. Unchanged criteria come from cache; only new or changed ones are sent to the model.
cl.not_dirty_note: No changes: version v{v} will be activated (if not already active) and applied to the selected dialogs.
cl.step_evaluating: Version v{v} is active. Evaluating the selected dialogs…
cl.apply_note: Version v{v} applied. For each dialog, it shows which criteria were sent to the model and which were taken from cache.
cl.replace_hint: Pick a template or start with a blank criterion. The old criterion will be removed and the new one added — in a new draft version.
cl.weights_note: Sum of weights: {sum}. The total is normalized to 100: each criterion's share = weight / sum of weights of applicable criteria. N/A criteria are excluded and their weight is redistributed.
cl.v_dup: This code or ID is already in use.
cl.v_scale: The scale must have at least 2 steps.
cl.v_scale_dup: Scale step values must be unique.
ap.title: Appeals
ap.lead: Queue: open ones first, then by model confidence. The reviewer makes the decision; the original score stays visible.
ap.empty_hint: An operator can dispute a criterion in the dialog card with the «Dispute» button.
ap.pick_hint: The appeal queue is on the left.
ap.advisory: advisory, a human makes the decision
ap.d_confirm_hint: The value stays, the total does not change.
ap.d_change_hint: The total is recalculated by the shared scoring engine.
ap.preview_engine: Preview calculated by the same engine as on the server.
ap.reason_ph: Why this decision was made; which messages it relies on.
cal.title: Calibration
cal.lead: Model agreement with human labels on the labeled set. Figures are given with a 95% confidence interval.
cal.empty_title: Calibration has not been run yet
cal.empty_hint: Run npm run calibrate or click the button — the report will appear here.
cal.kappa_note: Dashed line — κ = 0.6. A wide interval means a small sample: read the figure together with the interval.
cal.disagreements_hint: the link opens the dialog card
ins.title: Insights
ins.lead: What the data says about support quality: distributions, problem criteria, languages and channels, gross errors, coaching.
ins.empty_hint: Run an evaluation on the «Dialogs» screen — analytics will appear here.
ins.seg_title: Average total by language and channel
ins.fr_sub: informational: the 3 min threshold does not affect the score
ins.fr_x: From escalation to the operator's first message
ins.voice_sub: hold and consultations are excluded from the client communication score
ins.coach_sub: two most frequent «No» answers and a sample message; dialogs under appeal are excluded
ins.disputes_sub: appeals by criterion — a signal of flawed wording
ins.usage_note: The results are intended for coaching and human review; they are not a basis for automated HR decisions and do not assess emotions.
lang.model_note: Model rationales are written in Russian, the language of the checklist.
reason.fallback: model answer failed validation — rules used
zoom.title: Large text for projectors
static.banner: View-only demo — full version: npm start
static.readonly: This is a view-only demo: changes are not saved. To evaluate conversations, file and decide appeals or save checklists, run the full product locally: npm start (http://localhost:8080).
static.not_in_snapshot: This data is not part of the demo snapshot. Full version: npm start.
dialogs.fetch_url_fixed: Source: the organizers’ API from the server settings (CQA_DATA_URL); another address cannot be used.
dialogs.eval_checklist_hint: Defaults to the active version. Unchanged criteria are taken from stored results.
cl.offline_needs_model: Offline mode: criteria {list} are new or changed and need a model call. Without a model you can change weights and rule-based criteria.
cl.offline_rescore_only: Offline mode: no model is called — weight and rule-criterion changes are re-scored from stored answers.
dialogs.results_json_hint: Results of the set in the organizers' format (JSON 1.0), validated before download
